# How much failed-payment revenue are you actually losing?

> Free Stripe failed payment recovery analyzer: drop in your Stripe payments CSV and see how much failed-payment revenue you recover, what you lose, by decline reason and how fast. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
